quest_objectives.description: This file documents the available objective types. Objectives are typically defined inline within quests.json, but this file can be used for shared/reusable objective templates.

types.kill_named: Kill a specific named enemy (target = enemy_id)
types.kill_count: Kill X enemies of a type (target = enemy_id or type, count = number)
types.gather: Collect X items (target = item_id, count = number)
types.delivery: Bring an item to an NPC (target = npc_id)
types.interact: Interact with object(s) (target = object_id, count = number)
types.defend: Survive waves/time (target = zone_id, count = waves or seconds)
types.use_ability: Use specific ability X times (target = ability_id, count = number)
types.defeat_no_kill: Reduce enemy HP without killing (target = enemy_id)
types.race: Reach location within time limit (target = zone_id, count = seconds)
